options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Sets the goal of your world.

- **Milky Way Wishes:** Defeat Marx and complete Milky Way Wishes.
- **Main-Game Completion:** Complete a set of required Main Games.
- **The Arena:** Complete The Arena.
- **Revenge of the King:** Defeat Masked Dedede and complete Revenge of the King.
- **Meta Knightmare Ultra:** Defeat Galacta Knight and complete Meta Knightmare Ultra.
- **Marx Soul:** Unlock the true arena and defeat Marx Soul.
options.doc_html:
Sets the goal of your world.

  • Milky Way Wishes: Defeat Marx and complete Milky Way Wishes.
  • Main-Game Completion: Complete a set of required Main Games.
  • The Arena: Complete The Arena.
  • Revenge of the King: Defeat Masked Dedede and complete Revenge of the King.
  • Meta Knightmare Ultra: Defeat Galacta Knight and complete Meta Knightmare Ultra.
  • Marx Soul: Unlock the true arena and defeat Marx Soul.

- **Milky Way Wishes:** Vaincre Marx et complète la Voie lactée.
- **Main-Game Completion:** Complétez une série de Jeux principaux requis.
- **The Arena:** Complétez l'aréna.
- **Revenge of the King:** Vaincre la Dedede Masquée et la vengeance complète du Roi.
- **Meta Knightmare Ultra:** Vaincre Galacta Knight et complète Meta Knightmare Ultra.
- **Marx Soul:** Débloquer la vraie arène et vaincre Marx Soul.

options.name: Required Main-Game Completions
options.doc:
How many main-games must be completed for the game to be considered complete.

This option only applies when Main-Game Completion is set as the goal.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de jeux principaux doivent être complétés pour que le jeu soit considéré comme complet.

Cette option ne s'applique que lorsque l'achèvement du jeu principal est défini comme objectif.

options.name: Required Main-Games
options.doc: Which main-games are required to be completed for the game to be considered complete.

options.name: Starting Main-Game
options.doc: The main-game that will be unlocked by default.

options.name: Included Main-Games
options.doc: Which main-games should be included as locations.

options.name: Include Sub-Games
options.doc:
If enabled, all Sub-Games will be included as location checks.

This includes Megaton Punch, Samurai Kirby, Kirby Card Swipe, Kirby on the Draw, and Snack Tracks.
Sub-Games will not count towards the Main-Game Completion goal.
options.doc_fr:
Si activé, tous les sous-jeux seront inclus comme vérifications de localisation.

Cela inclut Megaton Punch, Samurai Kirby, Kirby Card Swipe, Kirby on the Draw et Snack Tracks.
Les sous-jeux ne comptent pas pour l'objectif d'achèvement du jeu principal.

options.name: The Great Cave Offensive Areas
options.doc:
Determines how new areas are unlocked in The Great Cave Offensive

Key: New areas are unlocked with progressive keys found in the pool. Four keys are required to finish the mode.

Gold: Certain gold thresholds must be met before progressing into the next area. This means collecting
enough treasure to reach a specified amount of gold.
options.doc_fr:
Détermine comment de nouvelles zones sont déverrouillées dans The Great Cave Offensive

Key: De nouvelles zones sont déverrouillées avec des clés progressives trouvées dans la piscine. Quatre clés sont nécessaires pour terminer le mode.

Gold: Certains seuils d'or doivent être atteints avant de passer à la prochaine zone. Cela signifie recueillir suffisamment de trésors pour atteindre une quantité déterminée d'or.

options.name: The Great Cave Offensive Extra Keys
options.doc:
Determines how many extra keys are added in the pool for The Great Cave Offensive.

This option only applies when Keys is selected for the area option.
options.doc_fr:
Détermine combien de clés supplémentaires sont ajoutées dans la piscine pour The Great Cave Offensive.

Cette option s'applique uniquement lorsque Keys est sélectionné pour l'option zone.

options.name: The Great Cave Offensive Required Gold
options.doc: Required amount of gold that is needed in order to complete The Great Cave Offensive.
options.doc_fr: Quantité d'or nécessaire pour compléter la Grande Cave Offensive.

options.name: The Great Cave Offensive Gold Thresholds
options.doc:
Percentange of the required gold required before allowing access to
Crystal/Old Tower/Garden areas in The Great Cave Offensive
options.doc_fr: Pourcentage de l'or requis requis avant de permettre l'accès aux zones Crystal/Old Tower/Jardin dans la Grande Grotte Offensive

options.name: The Great Cave Offensive Excess Gold
options.doc:
Percentange of the excess gold kept within the multiworld.

This option only applies if the required number of gold is less than the max.
options.doc_fr:
Pourcentage de l'excédent d'or conservé dans le multimonde.

Cette option ne s'applique que si le nombre d'or requis est inférieur au maximum.

options.name: Milky Way Wishes Mode
options.doc:
Determines how Marx is unlocked in Milky Way Wishes.

Local: Marx is unlocked after completing the 7 main planets
(Floria, Aquarius, Skyhigh, Hotbeat, Cavius, Mekkai, Halfmoon)

Multiworld: Marx is unlocked after receiving 7 Rainbow Stars scattered across the multiworld
options.doc_fr:
Détermine comment Marx est déverrouillé dans les vœux de la Voie lactée.

Local: Marx est déverrouillé après avoir complété les 7 planètes principales (Floria, Verseau, Skyhigh, Hotbeat, Cavius, Mekkai, Halfmoon)

Multiworld: Marx est déverrouillé après avoir reçu 7 Rainbow Stars dispersés dans le multimonde

options.name: Milky Way Wishes Mode
options.doc:
[Not currently implemented] 
Determines how locations in Helper to Hero are determined.

Off: Helper to Hero will behave like The Arena. Each win is counted as a location.

Simple: Completing Helper to Hero with different helpers will send a location.

Full: For each helper, each win will be counted as a location.

options.name: Foodsanity
options.doc:
[Not currently implemented]

Adds the specified consumables to the location pool. 
Options are Maxim Tomato, 1-Up, and Invincibility Candy.

options.name: Essence-sanity
options.doc:
[Not currently implemented]
Adds Copy Essence pedestals across all main-games to the location pool.
This includes Dyna Blade, The Great Cave Offensive, Gourmet Race, Revenge Of Meta Knight, and Milky Way Wishes

AKA Essence-Sanity.

options.doc: Adds 6 extra locations for beating a foe on each level in Megaton Punch.
options.doc_fr: Ajoute 6 emplacements supplémentaires pour battre un ennemi à chaque niveau dans Megaton Punch.

options.name: Samurai Kirby Difficulty

options.doc_fr: Ajoute des emplacements supplémentaires pour battre un ennemi sur chaque difficulté à Samurai Kirby.

options.name: Samurai Kirby Wins
options.doc:
How many opponents / wins can be included as progressive locations in Samurai Kirby.

This option only applies if the extra locations for each difficulty is disabled.
options.doc_fr:
Combien d'opposants / victoires peuvent être inclus comme des emplacements progressifs dans Samourai Kirby.

Cette option ne s'applique que si les emplacements supplémentaires pour chaque difficulté sont désactivés.

options.doc: Replace a percentage of filler items in the item pool with random traps.
options.doc_fr: Remplacer un pourcentage d'articles de remplissage dans le pool d'articles par des pièges aléatoires.

options.name: Eject Trap Weight
options.doc:
"
The chance of receiving a trap which ejects Kirby's current ability.

For Meta Knightmare Ultra, this will instead get rid of the helper if summoned.
For Helper to Hero, this will instead play a short animation.
options.doc_fr:
"
La chance de recevoir un piège qui éjecte la capacité actuelle de Kirby.

Pour Meta Knightmare Ultra, cela se débarrassera plutôt de l'aide si convoquée.
Pour Helper to Hero, cela jouera plutôt une courte animation.
